comment: The timing-failure rule's quarantine (register item 50a, owner, 18 October 2026; #1857). scripts/timing-rule.ts reads it and holds every rule.

A suite goes in after two merge-group runs where it failed apart from the diff (`timing` names both run ids), with a ticket to fix it. While its ticket is open and before `expires` (at most 14 days after `added`), a merge group that does not touch it leaves it out, and .github/workflows/quarantine-nightly.yml runs it each night.
A closed ticket or a passed expiry puts it back in the merge group. Remove the entry in the fix's pull request. A malformed entry fails the database shards.

tests.reason: The expiry case samples the operator's promise state on a timer instead of observing its lock wait, so under load it reads 'finished' where it needs 'waiting' (line 91). Fixed by #1800.
